mainEntity.name: Should I change real estate agents for an expired listing relaunch?

acceptedAnswer.text: Changing real estate agents for an expired listing relaunch can offer a fresh perspective and a new marketing approach, which can be beneficial if your previous agent's strategy wasn't effective. When considering a new agent, it's important to evaluate their market knowledge, marketing plan, and communication style. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution offers a complimentary consultation to outline their specific strategy for expired listings, allowing you to compare approaches and decide if a change aligns with your selling goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Changing agents can offer a fresh perspective. Evaluate a new agent's market knowledge, marketing, and communication before deciding.
